title: Common providers: New Zealand
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the mobile network operators, the four wholesale fibre networks and the common satellite service; smaller retail providers and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Smaller retail broadband providers, among them the power companies other than Mercury
A register of operators (none that could be read was found on the read date)
A status page for One NZ (the address answered with a page-not-found page on the read date)

sources.name: Commerce Commission: telecommunications
sources.terms: Crown copyright; the site's copyright page licenses its material under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 unless marked otherwise. Nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. Its market monitoring reports are the place to look for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in New Zealand and Telecommunications in New Zealand
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and ownership (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 5 of 13 names were found on the pages.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 13 of 13 websites and 4 business, support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty. An address that answered only with a refusal, a bot check or a page-not-found page counts as one that did not answer.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat service terms were read on the read date; RIPEstat data is not redistributed: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, the registered holder and that the number is announced.
sources.result: 18 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company, or that was not announced on the read date, was left out.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 2 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: 2degrees
providers.notes: Mobile and fixed; Orcon, Slingshot and Flip are its companies.

providers.name: Chorus
providers.notes: The largest wholesale fibre and copper network: the retail provider's name is on the bill.

providers.name: Northpower Fibre
providers.notes: Wholesale fibre network. The AS number is registered to Northpower.

providers.name: Mercury
providers.notes: The second address is its broadband page.
